title: DIR-091: 100% Pixel-Perfect Reference Parity for Candidate Dashboard and Build Resume (Two-Page Operational Parity)
spec: Developer must review his work in patch 01a12b9e-91b4-7174-9f95-41baa9990820.patch against certified HEAD (42d51bfc) and achieve 100% pixel-perfect reference parity and operational connections for both attached reference views: (1) Candidate Dashboard (/dashboard) and (2) Build Resume (/build-resume/*). Retain high-value builder enhancements (AI autofill, section reset with confirmation, StepGuide assistant rail, breadcrumb navigation) while ensuring Cuba sidebar shell framing, operational controls, and zero-diff cv-templates.
invariants: Zero modifications to src/cv-templates/ (diff must remain exactly 0).

Zero hardcoded mock data: all candidate names, resume cards, ATS scores, job application counts, and match metrics must bind directly to real database records, props, or deterministic calculation engines (calculateAtsScore). Zero synthetic mock strings or hardcoded numbers in production code paths. When records are unresolved or empty, render honest empty states or placeholders (e.g. '—').
Single-viewport layout lock and Cuba design token system compliance (no ad-hoc random colors).
No external heavy charting dependencies (SVG/CSS only for gauges and bars).
acceptanceCriteria: AC1: Reconcile patch 01a12b9e-91b4-7174-9f95-41baa9990820.patch against HEAD (42d51bfc5058b1e5f78d1b65f67c446b4653feaf) without breaking certified DIR-090/DIR-093 Candidate Dashboard reference parity.

AC2: Candidate Dashboard (/dashboard) achieves 100% pixel-perfect parity with .bridge/references/candidate-dashboard-target-reference.png: unified Cuba sidebar shell (Overview active, Upgrade to Pro banner), global search top bar with AI Assistant pill and profile, 'Good morning, Bhaskar! 👋' hero with quote and action pills, 4 top metric cards (Total Resumes 5, Avg ATS 69% gauge, Job Applications 1, Interview Coach Ready), Resumes toolbar with real filtering/sorting/view toggle, 4 resume cards + 5th 'Create a New Resume' card, 3-column bottom analytics (Application Progress bar chart, Top Job Matches, Your Next Steps), and right-rail AI Career Assistant (Tabs: Suggestions, Resume Insights, Job Match + chat input + Today's Insights).

AC3: Build Resume (/build-resume/*) achieves 100% pixel-perfect parity with .bridge/references/build-resume-target-reference.png: framed within Cuba sidebar shell (Resumes & Master CV active pill), top breadcrumb (Dashboard > Resumes & Master CV > Build Resume > [Name]), header with green Saved badge, 69/100 ATS gauge, Preview and Download buttons; horizontal step navigation with sub-labels (Personal info / Basic details, Work history / Experience, etc.); step card with 5/5 required fields badge, Complete pill, 'Auto Fill with AI' and 'Reset Section' buttons; photo uploader with recommendations note; 2-column input fields with icons; collapsible 'More details (optional)' and 'Target Role & Job Description'; step footer; and right-rail AI Career Assistant with screening checklist, section tips, and Bullet Strength gauge.

AC4: Operational Connections & Interactive Flows: Edit Resume opens /build-resume/:id; breadcrumb returns to /dashboard; 'Auto Fill with AI' triggers profile/JD population; 'Reset Section' shows confirmation before clearing; right-rail tabs switch smoothly; step navigation advances and saves; accordions expand/collapse.
AC5: All regression test suites pass (dir084-dir095 green), zero diff in src/cv-templates/, and visual evidence artifacts verified.
